title: Pesticide Safety Plan
description: Free Pesticide Safety Plan template for agriculture you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers product register, before application, mixing, application and cleaning.

Product Register

ProductActive ingredientHazard class / signal wordRe-entry intervalPre-harvest intervalPPE required

Before Application

☐ Label read; use only according to the label and local law

☐ Applicator trained and certified; fit for respirator use

☐ Weather checked: avoid wind drift, rain and temperature extremes

☐ Neighbours, water bodies and sensitive areas identified; buffers observed

☐ Equipment calibrated and checked for leaks

☐ Warning signs posted; re-entry restrictions communicated

Mixing, Application And Cleaning

☐ Mix in a ventilated area with PPE: gloves, goggles, respirator, coverall

☐ Use closed transfer where possible; avoid spills

☐ Triple-rinse empty containers; use rinsate in the tank

☐ Wash equipment away from water sources

☐ Wash hands and shower after work; wash PPE separately

Emergency

SituationAction
Skin contactRemove contaminated clothes, wash with soap and water for 15 minutes
Eye contactRinse eyes for 15 minutes, seek medical help
Inhalation or ingestionMove to fresh air, do not induce vomiting unless the label says so, call poison centre
SpillContain, absorb, collect for disposal, prevent entry to drains and water

Records

1. Record product, rate, area, date, weather, applicator and re-entry interval for every

application, and keep records as required by law.
